The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the traveler checks the details before moving on. Next, the traveler considers Treadmill, Oxygen Generator, Comm Dish, and Viewport. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the traveler checks the details before moving on. Next, the traveler considers Spacewalk, Experiment, Dock, and Orbit. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the traveler checks the details before moving on. Finally, the traveler considers Float, Exercise, and Repair. The choice depends on the role of each term in the context, so the traveler checks the details before moving on. By the end, the traveler can explain the decision clearly and use the new words in a connected response.
